topic: When the goal feels too big: picturing all the months of training ahead at once makes today feel heavy enough to skip; we stop carrying the whole road and only ask whether this one session, this one set, is really beyond us
figure: Marcus Aurelius, Roman emperor and Stoic, 121-180 AD (Meditations 8.36: do not let the picture of your whole life crush you or gather up in your mind all the troubles to come; ask of each present thing what in it is unbearable, and you will be ashamed to answer). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request
